[사전행사 1] 

제32회 국내학술대회 <한국무용제전 40년의 기록과 미래를 위한 담론>

한국무용제전 40주년의 사전행사로서 국내학술대회 <한국무용제전 40년의 기록과 미래를 위한 담론>이 사전행사로 개최됩니다. (사)한국춤협회의 산하기관인 한국무용연구학회와 함께 개최하는 이번 학술대회에서는지난 40년간 한국무용제전이 축적해온 한국창작춤의 흐름과 성과를 학술적으로 조망하고, 그 예술적 가치와 시대적 의미를 재해석하며 앞으로의 방향과 담론을 모색하는 연구 발표가 이루어집니다. 한국창작춤과 학술이 만나는 담론의 장을 4월 3일(금) 오후 1시, 예술가의집 다목적홀에서 만나볼 수 있습니다.

[사전행사 2] <매력시리즈 - 서울의 거리 Dance Film>

매력의 도시 서울을 한국춤으로 담아낸다. 과거와 현재, 그리고 미래가 공존하며 세계적으로 그 아름다움을 인정받고 있는 서울의 거리와 공간을 한국무용수들이 찾아가 춤으로 표현한다. 한국무용제전의 사전행사로 주목받고 있는 ‘매력시리즈 - 서울의 거리 Dance Film’은 지금까지 을지로, 서순라길, 청계천, 종묘사잇길, 광화문태평로, 성균관로, 서촌길, 열린송현녹지광장, 서울역, 해방촌, 노원공릉숲길 등 서울의 다양한 장소에서 한국춤의 매력을 새롭게 그려내며 도시와 춤이 만나는 장면들을 기록해 왔다.

이번 댄스필름은 지난 2025 제39회 한국무용제전의 소극장부문 심사위원특별상 수상자인 박철순이 고덕수변생태공원을, 소극장부문에서 인상깊은 작품을 선보인 양지수가 서대문형무소를 춤으로 걸으며 40주년을 맞이한 한국무용제전을 더욱 특별하게 빛내줄 예정입니다. 또한 높은 조회수를 기록한 작품에는 베스트 Click상을 수여하여 안무자들의 창작 활동에 대한 노고를 치하하고 작품의 대중적 확산과 향후 창작 활동에 의미 있는 성과로 이어질 수 있도록 할 예정입니다. 4월 6일(월) 양지수, 7일(화) 박철순의 영상이 ‘한국춤협회’ 유튜브 채널을 통해 오후 7시 30분에 공개되며, 언제 어디서나 장소에 구애받지 않고 서울의 거리를 춤으로 만날 수 있습니다.

[부대행사] 40주년 기념 아카이빙 전시 <한국무용제전 40년, 그 시간의 기록> 

한국무용제전 40주년을 기념하여 부대행사 아카이빙 전시 <한국무용제전 40년, 그 시간의 기록>이 진행됩니다. 이번 전시는 제1회 한국무용제전부터 제40회에 이르기까지 축적된 공연 자료를 아카이빙하여 그 변화의 흐름과 기록을 공유하고, 한국창작춤의 계보와 담론을 체계적으로 살펴볼 수 있도록 기획되었습니다. 한국무용제전이 걸어온 40년의 시간 속에서 한국창작춤이 어떻게 변화하고 확장되어 왔는지를 다양한 기록 자료를 통해 만나볼 수 있습니다.

아르코예술극장 대극장 로비에서 진행되는 이번 아카이빙 전시는 한국무용제전 40년의 순간들을 사진과 영상으로 담아내어 한국창작춤의 역사와 흐름을 관객들과 함께 나누고자 합니다. <한국무용제전 40년, 그 시간의 기록> 전시는 4월 8일(수)부터 4월 19일(일)까지 아르코예술극장 대극장 로비에서 무료로 관람할 수 있습니다.

<2026 제40회 한국무용제전 - The Path, 몸의 궤적> 에서 발표된 총 20개의 작품 중 대극장 부문에서 최우수, 우수작품상과 일반관객특별상, Best Dance 춤연기상이, 소극장 부문에서 최우수, 우수안무상, 심사위원특별상이 선정된다. 특히 올해는 좋은 안무와 작품을 보여준 안무자들을 위하여 대극장 부문에 선정된 8인을 “올해의 춤작가” 선정증서 수여와 함께 훌륭한 무용수들의 노고도 치하할 수 있게 되었다. 


[시놉시스]

[개막초청공연] 한국춤협회 명예이사장의 무대를 시작으로 이사진이 함께하는 뜻깊은 프로젝트와 한국창작춤의 현재를 보여주는 작품까지 이어지는 개막초청공연

한국무용제전의 개막초청공연은 한국무용제전을 위해 마음을 모은 많은 예술가들의 훌륭한 작품으로 꾸며집니다. 먼저 10여년 간 이사장으로서 한국춤협회를 이끌었던 명예이사장 윤덕경의 <밤의 소리>가 펼쳐집니다. <밤의 소리>는 안중식의 동양화 '성재수간도(聲在樹間圖)‘에서 영감을 받아 황병기선생께서 작곡한 곡을 ‘1990 현대춤작가전’에서 초연한 독무 작품입니다. 고요 속에서 증폭되는 울림, 그 밀도 높은 순간을 표현하는 작품입니다.

올해의 한국무용제전을 빛내는 특별 무대! 한국무용제전 40주년 프로젝트팀의 <춤, 그 신명>이 펼쳐집니다. 남녀노소 누구나 즐길 수 있는 작품인 <춤, 그 신명>은 1982년 초연되어, 관객이나 춤꾼이 합일을 통해 생성되는 또 다른 층위의 완성을 꾀하는 작품입니다. 작품 속의 춤꾼과 연주자, 그리고 관객들과의 소통으로 상생구조가 형성되며 사물연주와 현대음악의 접목, 연희성을 연극적 요소와 전통 복식의 현대적 착용으로 시각적인 미장센 연출로 작품을 극대화한 작품입니다. 이번 <춤, 그 신명> 무대는 한국춤협회의 이사진인 임현선, 이애현, 김용철 등 10명의 춤예술가들이 이번 한국무용제전을 위해 마음을 모았습니다. 한국무용제전 40주년을 맞아 한국춤협회 예술가들이 함께 만들어내는 또 하나의 ‘신명’의 무대가 펼쳐질 예정입니다. 

마지막으로 2025 제39회 한국무용제전 대극장부문 최우수작품상의 영예를 안은 (사)무용단 Altimeets 전수현의 작품 <공명과 신비>가 공연됩니다. 전수현 안무자의 <공명과 신비>는 우리의 말과 음악, 예술의 시간을 넘은 공명과 재탄생을 이야기하는 작품입니다. 땅을 울리는 듯한 군무의 에너지, 한국 예술의 해체와 재조합을 통한 울림을 선사합니다.  세 작품을 통해 한국춤의 역사와 현재, 그리고 새로운 울림을 만날 수 있는 이번 한국무용제전 개막초청공연은 관객 여러분께 깊이 있는 춤의 감동을 전할 것입니다.

[본공연] 2026 제40회 한국무용제전 <The Path, 몸의 궤적> 스무 명의 안무자가 선보이는 신작무대!

한국무용제전의 본공연은 〈The Path, 몸의 궤적〉을 주제로 한 작품들의 경연 무대로 펼쳐집니다. 대극장부문은 아르코예술극장 대극장에서 여덟 명의 안무자가 선보이는 신작으로 구성되며, 소극장부문은 동덕여자대학교 공연예술센터 코튼홀에서 열두 명의 안무가가 실험적이고 개성 있는 신작을 선보입니다. 경연 형식으로 진행되는 한국무용제전은 최우수 및 우수작품 선정을 통해 한국무용계의 차세대 안무가를 발굴하고, 한국창작춤의 대표 레퍼토리를 확장하며 새로운 예술적 시도를 이끄는 무용예술축제로 자리하고 있습니다.

[폐막초청공연 및 시상식] 한국창작춤의 부흥과 함께 한 작품, 그리고 새로운 감각의 수상작을 만나볼 수 있는 폐막초청공연

1980년대부터 지금까지 창작작업을 이어오며 부산 지역의 한국창작춤의 부흥을 이끌어 온  강미리할무용단의 <염(念)>을 폐막초청공연에서 만나실 수 있습니다. 작품 <염(念)>은 승무를 깊이 있게 해석해 낸 작품으로, ‘한국 전통춤의 한계에 대한 실험이자 넘쳐남에 대한 또 다른 실험이며 반드시 해야 할 필연적인 작업이다’라는 평을 들은 바 있습니다. 전통춤의 변용과 해체를 넘나들며 한국창작춤의 정체성과 입지를 단단하게 한 <염(念)>은 이번 폐막초청공연의 무대를 더욱 빛내줄 예정입니다.

뒤이어 2025년 제39회 한국무용제전 대극장부문 우수작품상 수상작인 Dance us project 김현선의 <이방인들>이 공연된다. 어떤 곳에 섞이지 못하는 이를 이방인으로 표현하며 누구나 이방인이 될 수 있기에 그 차이를 인정하고 공존해야 한다는 메세지를 담고 있습니다.

마지막으로 진행되는 시상식에서는 2026 제40회 한국무용제전 <The Path, 몸의 궤적>을 빛내준 수상작품들을 발표합니다. 총 20개의 작품 중 대극장 부문에서 최우수, 우수작품상과 관객특별상, 그리고 Best Dance 춤연기상이, 소극장 부문에서 최우수, 우수안무상, 심사위원특별상이 선정됩니다. 더불어 대극장부문에 선정된 8인의 안무가들에게 수여되는 ‘올해의 춤작가’ 선정증서와 사전행사 서울의거리 Dance film의 인기상이라고 할 수 있는 베스트 Click상까지 수여될 예정이니 많은 관심 부탁드립니다.

한국창작춤이 쌓아온 마흔 겹의 시간, 그리고 그 위로 겹쳐질 새로운 몸짓이 펼쳐지는 이번 2026 제40회 한국무용제전 <The Path, 몸의 궤적>을 함께 해주십시오.

The 32nd Domestic Academic Conference <Records of 40 Years of the Korean Dance Festival and Discourse for the Future>

As a preliminary event for the 40th anniversary of the Korean Dance Festival, the domestic academic conference <Records of 40 Years of the Korean Dance Festival and Discourse for the Future> will be held. Co-hosted with the Korean Dance Research Society, an affiliate of the Korea Dance Association, this conference will feature research presentations that academically survey the trends and achievements of Korean creative dance accumulated by the Korean Dance Festival over the past 40 years, reinterpret its artistic value and significance for the times, and explore future directions and discourse. You can experience this forum for discourse where Korean creative dance meets academia on Friday, April 3, at 1:00 PM in the Multipurpose Hall of the House of Artists.

[Pre-event 2] <Charm Series - Streets of Seoul Dance Film>

Capturing the charm of Seoul through Korean dance. Korean dancers visit the streets and spaces of Seoul, where the past, present, and future coexist and whose beauty is recognized globally, to express them through dance. The ‘Charm Series - Seoul Street Dance Film,’ which is garnering attention as a preliminary event for the Korean Dance Festival, has so far recorded scenes where the city and dance meet by newly portraying the charm of Korean dance in various locations across Seoul, including Euljiro, Seosunra-gil, Cheonggyecheon, Jongmyo-saigil, Gwanghwamun-Taepyeong-ro, Sungkyunkwan-ro, Seochon-gil, Yeollin Songhyeon Green Plaza, Seoul Station, Haebangchon, and Nowon Gongneung Forest Path.

This dance film is set to make the 40th anniversary of the Korean Dance Festival even more special, featuring Park Cheol-sun, winner of the Special Jury Prize in the Small Theater category at the 39th Korean Dance Festival in 2025, performing at Godeok Waterfront Ecological Park, and Yang Ji-soo, who presented an impressive work in the Small Theater category, walking through Seodaemun Prison by dance. In addition, the "Best Click Award" will be presented to works that record high view counts to commend the choreographers for their hard work in creative activities, promote the public dissemination of their works, and ensure that this leads to meaningful achievements in future creative endeavors. Videos by Yang Ji-soo on April 6 (Mon) and Park Cheol-soon on April 7 (Tue) will be released on the "Korea Dance Association" YouTube channel at 7:30 PM, allowing you to experience the streets of Seoul through dance anytime, anywhere, without being restricted by location.

[Side Event] 40th Anniversary Archiving Exhibition <40 Years of the Korea Dance Festival: A Record of That Time>

To commemorate the 40th anniversary of the Korea Dance Festival, the side event archiving exhibition <40 Years of the Korea Dance Festival: A Record of That Time> will be held. This exhibition is designed to archive performance materials accumulated from the 1st to the 40th Korea Dance Festival, share the flow of change and records, and allow for a systematic examination of the lineage and discourse of Korean creative dance. Through various archival materials, you can discover how Korean creative dance has evolved and expanded over the 40-year history of the Korea Dance Festival.

This archiving exhibition, held in the lobby of the Arko Arts Theater Grand Hall, captures moments from the festival's 40-year history through photographs and videos, aiming to share the history and flow of Korean creative dance with the audience. The exhibition, <40 Years of the Korea Dance Festival: A Record of That Time>, is free to view at the Arko Arts Theater Grand Hall lobby from April 8 (Wed) to April 19 (Sun).

[Synopsis]

[Opening Invitational Performance] The opening invitational performance begins with a stage by the Honorary Chairman of the Korea Dance Association and continues with meaningful projects involving the board of directors and works showcasing the current state of Korean creative dance.

The opening invitational performance of the Korea Dance Festival is comprised of excellent works by many artists who have united their hearts for the festival. First, <Sound of the Night> by Honorary Chairman Yoon Duk-kyung, who led the Korea Dance Association as chairman for over ten years, will be presented. <Sound of the Night> is a solo dance piece that premiered at the ‘1990 Contemporary Dance Artists Exhibition,’ featuring a piece composed by Hwang Byung-ki inspired by Ahn Jung-sik’s Oriental painting, 'Seongjaesugando (Sound in the Trees).' This is a work that expresses the intensely dense moments of resonance amplified amidst silence.

A special stage illuminating this year's Korea Dance Festival! <Dance, That Exhilaration> by the Korea Dance Festival 40th Anniversary Project Team will be presented. A work that can be enjoyed by people of all ages, <Dance, That Exhilaration> premiered in 1982 and seeks to achieve a new level of perfection created through the unity of the audience and the dancers. A symbiotic structure is formed through communication between the dancers, musicians, and audience within the piece. The work maximizes its impact through visual mise-en-scène direction, combining Samulnori with contemporary music, incorporating theatrical elements into Yeonhee (traditional Korean performance), and modernizing traditional costumes. For this <Dance, That Exhilaration> stage, ten dance artists, including Lim Hyun-sun, Lee Ae-hyun, and Kim Yong-chul, who are board members of the Korea Dance Association, have come together with a shared vision for this year's Korea Dance Festival. In celebration of the 40th anniversary of the Korea Dance Festival, a stage of another 'Shinmyung' (exhilaration) created collectively by artists of the Korea Dance Association is set to unfold. Finally, <Resonance and Mystery> by Jeon Su-hyeon of the Altimeets Dance Company, which won the Grand Prize in the Grand Theater category at the 39th Korea Dance Festival in 2025, will be performed. Choreographer Jeon Su-hyeon’s <Resonance and Mystery> tells the story of resonance and rebirth that transcend time in our language, music, and art. It presents the energy of group dances that seem to shake the earth, and resonance achieved through the deconstruction and recombination of Korean art. Through these three works, this opening invitational performance of the Korea Dance Festival offers a chance to encounter the history, present, and new resonances of Korean dance, delivering the profound emotion of dance to the audience.

[Main Performance] 2026 40th Korea Dance Festival <The Path, The Trajectory of the Body> A stage of new works presented by twenty choreographers!

The main performance of the Korea Dance Festival unfolds as a competition stage featuring works under the theme of <The Path, The Trajectory of the Body>. The Grand Theater section features new works by eight choreographers at the Arko Arts Theater Grand Hall, while the Small Theater section presents experimental and distinctive new works by twelve choreographers at the Cotton Hall of the Dongduk Women's University Performing Arts Center. Conducted in a competition format, the Korean Dance Festival has established itself as a dance arts festival that discovers the next generation of choreographers in the Korean dance world through the selection of top and outstanding works, expands the representative repertoire of Korean creative dance, and leads new artistic endeavors.

[Closing Invitational Performance and Awards Ceremony] The Closing Invitational Performance offers a chance to experience works that have accompanied the revival of Korean creative dance, as well as award-winning pieces with a fresh sensibility.

At the Closing Invitational Performance, you can experience <Yeom (Thought)> by the Kang Miri Hal Dance Company, which has continued its creative work from the 1980s to the present and led the revival of Korean creative dance in the Busan region. The work *Yeom* offers a profound interpretation of Seungmu and has been praised as "an experiment on the limits of Korean traditional dance, another experiment on overflowing, and an inevitable undertaking." Traversing the transformation and deconstruction of traditional dance to solidify the identity and standing of Korean creative dance, *Yeom* is set to further illuminate the stage of this closing invitational performance.

Following this, *Strangers* by Kim Hyun-sun of the Dance us project will be performed. This piece is the winner of the Excellence Award in the Grand Theater category at the 39th Korea Dance Festival in 2025. It portrays those who cannot blend in as strangers, conveying the message that since anyone can become a stranger, we must acknowledge these differences and coexist.

Finally, the awards ceremony will announce the winning works that graced the 40th Korea Dance Festival in 2026, *The Path, The Trajectory of the Body*. Out of a total of 20 works, the Best Production Award, Excellent Production Award, Audience Special Award, and Best Dance Performance Award will be selected in the Grand Theater category, while the Best Choreography Award, Excellent Choreography Award, and Jury Special Award will be selected in the Small Theater category. In addition, certificates of selection as ‘Dance Artist of the Year’ will be presented to the eight choreographers selected in the Grand Theater category, along with the Best Click Award, which can be considered the popularity award for the pre-event ‘Street of Seoul Dance Film.’ We ask for your continued interest.

Please join us for the 40th Korean Dance Festival 2026, <The Path, The Trajectory of the Body>, where the forty layers of time accumulated by Korean creative dance and new movements to be superimposed upon them will unfold.

Located at 69, Sanroknam-ro 762beon-gil, Andeok-myeon, Seogwipo-si, Jeju, the Bontae Museum is a special space designed to harmonize with Jeju's beautiful nature.

"Bontae" means "original form," and the museum was established in 2012 to explore the inherent beauty of humanity through traditional and modern art.

Designed by world-renowned architect Tadao Ando, ​​it boasts a unique and sensuous architectural beauty where exposed concrete, light, and water blend together.

Based on the overarching themes of the meeting of nature and architecture, tradition and modernity, and the world and Korea, the museum operates various exhibitions, hands-on experiences, and educational programs.

The Bontae Museum consists of five exhibition halls.

Hall 1 – Traditional Crafts Hall
Various traditional lifestyle crafts, such as Korean small tables (soban), wooden furniture, bojagi (wrapping cloths), and pillows, are on display, allowing visitors to experience our ancient lifestyle culture and the beauty of artisans.

Hall 2 – Contemporary Art Museum
Contemporary art works by world-famous artists such as Picasso, Dali, Andy Warhol, and Nam June Paik are exhibited here. You can explore the trends of global art with your child.

Gallery 3 – Yayoi Kusama Special Hall
Representative works by Japanese contemporary art master Yayoi Kusama, such as "Pumpkin" and "Infinity Mirror Room," are on display, allowing children to have a fascinating art experience.

Gallery 4 – Traditional Funeral Hall
Crafts related to the funeral customs of the past, such as funeral biers and wooden figures, are exhibited here, making it easy and interesting to learn about our traditional culture.

Gallery 5 – Special Exhibition Hall
Special exhibitions with various themes are held depending on the season, so it is a good idea to check the exhibition information before visiting.

In addition to the indoor areas, there are various sculptures and beautiful walking paths outdoors, allowing families to walk together and experience both art and nature simultaneously.

Visiting the museum itself becomes an experience where you can view various artworks up close, fostering creativity and sensibility in children.

There are corners prepared where children can enter and experience unique spaces, such as Yayoi Kusama's "Infinity Mirror Room," making art a fun and engaging experience. At the Traditional Crafts Hall, you can naturally learn about our culture through familiar everyday objects, making it an educational experience.

Operating Hours: Daily 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Duration of Visit: Approximately 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours

Admission is free for infants under 36 months (proof of age required)

There is ample outdoor space, so we recommend a family stroll after viewing the exhibition.

It is located about 40 minutes by car from Jeju International Airport and about 15 minutes from the Jeju International Convention Center.

If using public transportation, it takes about 1 hour to 1 hour 20 minutes via bus and transfers.

Amenities Available: Diaper changing station, stroller rental, parking, reservations

Amenities Not Available: High chairs, nursing room

There are many stairs inside the museum, so moving around with a stroller may be difficult.

Admission is free for children under 36 months.

Re-observation Opportunity in Case of Inability: If normal observation is difficult due to weather or other factors, a free re-observation opportunity is provided within one year.

실내 전시와 체험은 로봇, 우주, 과학에 관심이 많거나 조금 더 큰 아이들에게 추천됩니다.
약 2천 평 규모의 실내 공간에는 약 500여 점의 실제 우주 전시물이 전시되어 있습니다.
우주 개발의 역사, 로켓과 우주선의 탄생 과정, 우주인의 생활, 화성과 달 탐험 등 다양한 테마로 꾸며진 전시관이 있어 아이와 함께 우주에 대해 쉽게 배우고 체험할 수 있습니다.

TranslationFormula:
Okto-tokki Space Center is Korea's first space science theme park, located on Ganghwa Island in Incheon. As a complex cultural space combining space, science, art, exploration, and play, it is an experiential travel destination designed to stimulate children's curiosity and creativity.

The indoor exhibits and activities are recommended for children who are interested in robots, space, and science, or for slightly older children.

The indoor space, spanning approximately 2,000 pyeong (about 6,600 square meters), displays around 500 actual space exhibits.

With exhibition halls featuring various themes such as the history of space development, the birth of rockets and spacecraft, the lives of astronauts, and exploration of Mars and the Moon, visitors can easily learn about and experience space with their children.

Vivid videos on the themes of space and science can be viewed in the 3D cinema.

Taking commemorative photos dressed as if wearing a spacesuit and riding six types of space experience rides are also very popular activities.

On a vast outdoor site spanning approximately 16,000 pyeong (about 53,000 square meters), a Dinosaur Forest has been created where large, moving dinosaurs come to life. Approximately 40 to 63 large dinosaur models are on display, offering an experience that feels like time travel to the dinosaur era.

There are various themed play areas, including a Robot Park, Water Cannon Park, Logos Garden, and a spacious observation tower.

The Four Seasons Sledding Park offers diverse sledding experiences (snow sledding, rubber sledding) depending on the season; it transforms into a water playground in the summer and a boating area in spring and autumn, allowing visitors to enjoy a variety of activities throughout the year.

A mini-train, boat rides, and a spacious landscaped area for outdoor play are also available.

Amenities provided: Nursing room, diaper changing station, stroller rental, parking, reservations

Amenities not provided: High chairs

Discounts are available when booking via Naver.

Parking Lot 1 is closest to the entrance. Address: 403, Ganghwadong-ro, Buleun-myeon, Ganghwa-gun, Incheon

1st Floor: Aviation Hall

This section consists of exhibits on the history and principles of airplanes, displays of various aircraft models, and a space where visitors can experience the cockpit of an actual airplane. A photo zone is also available where visitors can take pictures wearing various professional uniforms, such as those of pilots, mechanics, and flight attendants.

2nd Floor: Space Hall

Along with exhibits related to space exploration, this section features galaxy-themed ceiling decorations, a 4D theater, a diorama zone, and models of future space and aviation cities. Visitors can also experience models that move when a button is pressed.

Experience Zone

There is a wealth of hands-on activities available, including making and flying paper airplanes, VR (Virtual Reality) simulators, and airplane escape slides.

In the 4D theater, special effects that stimulate the five senses—such as vibrations, wind, and scents—are added to the video, allowing visitors to indirectly experience actual flight or space exploration.

A T-50 Black Eagles flight simulation is also available.

Energy & Environment Experience

There is an energy experience zone where visitors can try powering an airplane using renewable energy, making it an excellent place to cultivate scientific thinking skills. The facility has been completely renovated, offering a pleasant interior, and various experiences and explanations tailored to children's perspectives are available.

Conveniences such as elevators, nursing rooms, diaper changing stations, stroller rentals, and parking are provided for a convenient visit.

Please note that exhibition and experience operating hours vary, and some programs, such as VR and 4D, require on-site registration or separate paid access. It is recommended to check the schedule and capacity limits in advance before visiting.

Located near the Sacheon Aerospace Museum, a combined admission ticket is available, allowing for a more enriching visit.

At the Aviation Industry Experience Hall on the first floor, visitors can wear costumes representing aviation professions (pilot, flight attendant, mechanic) and take photos at the photo zone.

Paper airplane flying and airplane assembly kit making experiences are available (4,000 KRW).

The 4D Theater is open to elementary school students and older, with a runtime of 17 minutes. Seats are available on a first-come, first-served basis with a total of 50 seats, so it is advisable to check in advance.

VR experiences include Paragliding Virtual Flight VR, Fighter Pilot VR, and Super Wings VR. On the second floor, you can enjoy free VR experiences and flight path simulations using air tubes.

At the space station, you can try on spacesuits, and coloring activities are also provided.

The Hydrogen Safety Museum is located at 360-33, Yeonmi-ro, Maengdong-myeon, Eumseong-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, and is an experience and education-focused exhibition hall operated by the Korea Gas Safety Corporation.

This museum provides information on gas and hydrogen safety in an easy and fun way. In particular, it offers various programs and exhibits designed to allow children to naturally broaden their understanding of future energy through hands-on experiences.

The first floor houses the lobby, information desk, lounge, and experience education rooms, while the second floor is equipped with spaces for full-scale experiences and education.

Gas Safety Experience Hall

Visitors can learn essential safety information for daily life, such as gas safety classes, basic gas knowledge, and emergency procedures for gas leaks, through intuitive graphics and interactive content.

In areas like 'Gas Safety Reminder' and the 'Gas Safety Chamber,' visitors can also participate in hands-on experiences where they can identify actual hazards and learn accident prevention methods.

We invite you to the world of microorganisms. Shall we all embark together on a journey into the world of microorganisms, which possess immense charm despite being invisible?

The SOMA Museum of Art is located within Olympic Park at 51, Wiryeoseong-daero, Songpa-gu, Seoul.

It possesses a history of transforming the cultural heritage of the 1988 Seoul Olympics into art. Opened in 2004 as the Seoul Olympic Museum of Art, it is now widely known by the name "SOMA."

The museum complex features the main building (Gallery 1), Gallery 2 (expanded in 2018), and a world-class outdoor sculpture park.

The sculpture park, spanning a total of 692,367 square meters, displays 221 contemporary sculptures by 155 artists from 66 countries. Visitors can freely stroll with their children while appreciating the artworks.

Designed by renowned architect Cho Seong-ryong, the museum building offers a unique atmosphere depending on the time of day and weather, thanks to a structure that blends natural light with diverse materials.

With various spaces including indoor and outdoor exhibition halls, a video art hall, studios, education rooms, and seminar rooms, visitors can engage not only in art appreciation but also in art experiences and educational activities. The outdoor park, where nature and sculpture harmonize, features walking paths, corridors, and a water garden, allowing you to stroll and play freely with your children.

Luggage lockers are available at the entrance for the convenience of leaving your belongings while viewing the exhibits, and there is also a souvenir shop before the exit.

Gallery 1 Operating Hours: 10:00 ~ 19:00

Closed every Monday

Docent Tours: Tuesday ~ Friday at 11:00, 14:00, and 16:00

[공연소개]

재즈 피아니스트 케니 배론은 서정성과 스윙, 그리고 정교한 화성 감각을 완벽한 균형으로 구현해 온 현대 재즈 피아노의 거장이다. 디지 길레스피, 스탠 게츠, 프레디 허바드 등 재즈사의 중심에 있는 거장들과의 협업을 통해 일찍이 음악적 존재감을 확립했으며, 이후 수십 년간 트리오, 솔로, 대편성에 이르기까지 폭넓은 형식 속에서 자신만의 음악 세계를 꾸준히 발전시켜 왔다. 그의 연주는 언제나 절제된 서정미와 깊은 스윙을 바탕으로, 재즈가 지닌 지적이면서도 따뜻한 매력을 전해주고 있다.

이번 공연은 케니 배런이 베이시스트 알렉시스 쿠아드라도, 드러머 조나단 블레이크와 함께 하는 트리오의 한국 첫 무대라는 점에서 특별한 의미를 지닌다. 특히 공연이 열리는 4월 30일은 유네스코가 지정한 재즈의 날로 올해 83세의 살아있는 재즈의 전설과 함께 이 특별한 날을 기념하는 특별한 무대가 될 것이다.

알렉시스 쿠아드라도는 바르셀로나 출신으로 뉴욕에서 활동하며 플라멩코의 열정과 현대 재즈의 지성을 결합한 독보적인 베이시스트다. 탄탄한 클래식 기교를 바탕으로 안젤리크 키조, 마크 터너 등 세계적 거장들과 협연하였다. 또한 작곡가이자 리더로서 서사적이고 정교한 연주를 구사하며, 케니 배런의 우아한 피아니즘에 깊이와 역동성을 더해줄 것이다.

드럼에는 현대 재즈 씬을 대표하는 연주자 중 한 명인 조나단 블레이크가 함께 한다. 조나단 블레이크는 전통적인 스윙 감각과 현대적인 리듬 해석을 동시에 갖춘 드러머로, 다이내믹하면서도 세밀한 연주로 높은 평가를 받아왔다. 그의 드러밍은 단순한 리듬 반주를 넘어, 피아노와 베이스 사이를 잇는 적극적인 대화의 역할을 수행하며 트리오 전체의 긴장감과 에너지를 끌어올린다.

이 세 명이 만들어내는 케니 배런 트리오는 클래식한 피아노 트리오의 형식을 바탕으로 하면서도, 각 연주자의 개성과 경험이 자연스럽게 어우러진 현대적 사운드를 들려줄 것이다. 정교하게 쌓아 올린 하모니, 여백을 살린 인터플레이, 그리고 순간의 영감을 놓치지 않는 즉흥 연주는 트리오 재즈가 지닌 가장 본질적인 매력을 선명하게 드러낸다. 특히 오랜 시간 무대 위에서 축적된 케니 배런의 음악적 통찰은 두 연주자와의 긴밀한 호흡 속에서 더욱 깊이 있게 빛을 발할 것이다.

재즈 데이를 기념해서 개최되는 이번 케니 배런 트리오의 공연은 단순한 내한 공연을 넘어, 동시대 재즈 트리오가 도달할 수 있는 가장 높은 완성도를 직접 확인할 수 있는 소중한 기회가 될 것이다. 재즈가 지닌 지적 깊이와 인간적인 따뜻함, 그리고 라이브 무대에서만 느낄 수 있는 생생한 호흡을 동시에 경험할 수 있는 이번 무대는 국내 재즈 팬들에게 오래도록 기억에 남을 특별한 순간이 될 것으로 기대된다.

[Concert Introduction]

Jazz pianist Kenny Barron is a master of modern jazz piano who has embodied lyricism, swing, and a sophisticated sense of harmony in perfect balance. He established his musical presence early on through collaborations with giants at the center of jazz history, such as Dizzy Gillespie, Stan Getz, and Freddie Hubbard, and has since steadily developed his own unique musical world over decades across a wide range of forms, from trios and solos to large-scale ensembles. His performances are always grounded in restrained lyricism and deep swing, conveying the intellectual yet warm charm inherent in jazz.

This concert holds special significance as it marks the first performance in Korea by the trio featuring Kenny Barron, bassist Alexis Cuadrado, and drummer Jonathan Blake. Notably, April 30th, the date of the concert, is UNESCO-designated International Jazz Day, making this a special stage to celebrate this unique day with the 83-year-old living legend of jazz.

Alexis Cuadrado, a Barcelona native based in New York, is an unrivaled bassist who combines the passion of flamenco with the intellect of modern jazz. Based on solid classical technique, he has collaborated with world-renowned masters such as Angelique Chizzo and Mark Turner. Furthermore, as a composer and leader, he employs narrative and sophisticated playing, adding depth and dynamism to Kenny Barron's elegant pianism.

Joining him on drums is Jonathan Blake, one of the leading figures in the contemporary jazz scene. Blake is a drummer who possesses both a traditional swing sensibility and a modern interpretation of rhythm, earning high acclaim for his dynamic yet detailed playing. His drumming goes beyond simple rhythmic accompaniment, acting as an active dialogue between the piano and bass to elevate the tension and energy of the entire trio.

The Kenny Barron Trio created by these three will present a modern sound rooted in the classical piano trio format, while naturally blending the individual personalities and experiences of each musician. Intricately layered harmonies, interplay that utilizes space, and improvisation that captures momentary inspiration clearly reveal the most essential charms of trio jazz. In particular, Kenny Barron’s musical insights, accumulated over many years on stage, will shine even more deeply through the close synergy with the two musicians.

Holded to commemorate Jazz Day, this performance by the Kenny Barron Trio goes beyond a simple visiting concert; it will be a valuable opportunity to witness firsthand the highest level of perfection achievable by a contemporary jazz trio. Offering a simultaneous experience of jazz’s intellectual depth, human warmth, and the vivid energy unique to a live stage, this performance is expected to be a special moment that will remain in the memories of Korean jazz fans for a long time.
Kumho Young Artist Concert, Kim Ga-eun Violin Recital

TranslationFormula:
[Performance Introduction]

This is a time for children and parents to comfortably encounter classical music together.

The performance is structured to help children naturally understand classical music they are hearing for the first time through stories and commentary.

This concert, titled "Lalala! A Concert for Children and Moms," introduces piano classical works that children can easily enjoy.

We present classical music with familiar melodies, such as Beethoven's *Für Elise*, Mozart's *Variations on *Twinkle Twinkle Little Star*, and Debussy's *Gollywog's Cakewalk*.

Through Chopin's Waltzes and various pieces from Saint-Saëns' *Carnival of Animals*, you can also encounter the diverse animals and stories featured in the music.

This is a program designed for children to listen to classical music without pressure and to experience the atmosphere and stories of the music together.
Kumho Young Talent Concert, Han Se-hee Recorder Recital

Voices that become a poem meet the orchestra.

The 'Special Concert' featuring La Poème and the Chungnam Symphony Orchestra is a special stage encompassing various genres, including pop, Korean ballads, and musicals.

La Poème, the world's first crossover group to include a traditional countertenor, presents a stage akin to a poem to the audience through the resonance rooted in vocal music and emotional expressiveness.

- 현대음악작곡가 최진석의 오케스트라 신작 <Four Pieces for Orchestra>
- 바젤 작곡 콩쿠르 3위의 현대음악 작곡가 최진석이 파도·어둠·빛·바람을 주제로 한 네 개의 장으로 이루어진 신작 오케스트라 작품을 선보인다.
현대음악작곡가 최진석의 오케스트라 신작 <Four Pieces for Orchestra>는 파도, 어둠, 빛, 바람을 주제로 한 네 개의 곡(장)으로 구성되어 있다. 각 장은 자연이 지닌 서로 다른 에너지와 상태를 음악적으로 탐구하며, 격렬함과 고요, 생성과 소멸, 긴장과 이완의 대비를 통해 하나의 연속적인 흐름을 형성한다. 작품 전반에서 자연의 움직임은 작곡가가 가장 중요하게 여기는 음악의 구조적 원리를 적용하여 묘사된다. 본 작품은 한경arte필하모닉의 연주와 김유원의 지휘로 초연된다.
TranslationFormula:
[Concert Introduction]

- Contemporary Composer Choi Jin-seok’s New Orchestral Work <Four Pieces for Orchestra>

- Contemporary composer Choi Jin-seok, 3rd Prize winner at the Basel Composition Competition, presents a new orchestral work composed of four movements themed around waves, darkness, light, and wind.

Contemporary composer Choi Jin-seok’s new orchestral work, <Four Pieces for Orchestra>, consists of four pieces (movements) themed around waves, darkness, light, and wind. Each movement musically explores the different energies and states inherent in nature, forming a continuous flow through contrasts of intensity and stillness, creation and destruction, and tension and relaxation. Throughout the work, the movements of nature are depicted by applying the structural principles of music that the composer considers most important. This work will have its premiere with the Hankyung arte Philharmonic Orchestra conducting Kim Yu-won.

“A Lullaby for Lost Youth” – Comfort Shared Between Schubert and 21st-Century Youth

Schubert, who sang of hope and despair from his sickbed in 1823. The wandering of the young miller he depicted reflects the anxiety and loneliness of us living in 2026. We encounter an ironic song cycle of youth where failure is okay and pain is beautiful.

Tenor Jin Sung-won, a professor at Gachon University who nurtures the next generation, possesses exceptional interpretive skills and a warm, beautiful voice. His voice unravels the human anguish and youthful imagery composed by Schubert with vocal depth!

Pianist Choi Eun-ju, with her seasoned and delicate touch. Her accompaniment embodies the essence of Schubert’s lieder through piano melodies, ranging from the whispers of the stream to the young man’s turbulent psychological shifts!

KBS’ rising talent, Announcer Kim Jin-woong. Original:
[공연소개]

UNDERCITY의 Soft Opening을 함께 열었던 Jeremy Olander가 1년 만에 다시 성수를 찾는다. 이번에는 단 한 번의 Set이 아닌, 밤의 시작부터 끝까지의 흐름을 하나의 서사로 완성하는 Open to Close ? All Night Long Set (6시간)으로 무대를 채운다.

Eric Prydz의 Pryda Friends를 통해 데뷔한 이후, Drumcode, Anjunadeep, Diynamic 등 세계적인 레이블을 넘나들며 그는 멜로딕 하우스와 테크노 신에서 가장 신뢰받는 프로듀서로 자리매김해왔다. 섬세한 사운드 디자인과 감정과 구조를 동시에 설계하는 셋 구성은 그의 가장 큰 시그니처다. 2014년 설립한 자신의 레이블 Vivrant를 통해 아티스트이자 큐레이터로서의 정체성도 확립해왔다.

이번 공연은 단순한 내한 공연이 아닌, Vivrant Showcase이자 그의 데뷔 앨범 When The Rain Falls 시대를 여는 상징적인 밤이다. 오는 3월 13일 발매되는 이 앨범은, 수년간의 예술적 진화와 삶의 변화를 담아낸 그의 가장 개인적이고 성찰적인 작품이다.

When The Rain Falls는 클럽을 위한 기능적 트랙이 아닌, ‘듣는 음악’으로서의 전자음악을 지향한다. 자신의 경험과 감정에 기반해 완성된 이 앨범은 Jeremy Olander가 새롭게 정의한 사운드의 방향성을 보여준다.

첫 싱글 ‘Apollo’를 시작으로 펼쳐지는 앨범의 세계관은 시네마틱한 사운드와 선명한 감정선을 중심으로, 다양한 협업을 통해 확장된 그의 음악적 스펙트럼을 드러낸다. 기존 프로그레시브 하우스를 넘어, 보다 성숙하고 서사적인 사운드로 진화한 전환점이다.
UNDERCITY에서 펼쳐질 이번 Open to Close Set은 그의 커리어와 앨범 서사, 그리고 Vivrant의 철학이 하나로 연결되는 순간이다. 이 밤은 그의 음악과 함께 성장해온 팬들에게, 오랫동안 기억될 특별한 경험으로 남을 것이다.
TranslationFormula:
[Concert Introduction]

Jeremy Olander, who co-hosted the soft opening of UNDERCITY, returns to Seongsu after a year. This time, rather than a single set, he will fill the stage with "Open to Close – All Night Long Set" (6 hours), completing the flow from the beginning to the end of the night as a single narrative.

Since his debut through Eric Prydz's Pryda Friends, he has crossed between world-renowned labels such as Drumcode, Anjunadeep, and Diynamic, establishing himself as one of the most trusted producers in the melodic house and techno scenes. His most significant signature is his delicate sound design and set composition that simultaneously designs emotion and structure. Through his own label, Vivrant, founded in 2014, he has also established his identity as both an artist and a curator.

This performance is not merely a visit to Korea, but a Vivrant Showcase and a symbolic night that ushers in the era of his debut album, *When The Rain Falls*. Releasing on March 13, this album is his most personal and reflective work, capturing years of artistic evolution and changes in his life.

"When The Rain Falls" aims for electronic music meant to be "listened to," rather than functional tracks for clubs. Completed based on his own experiences and emotions, this album showcases the direction of sound that Jeremy Olander has newly defined.

The album's worldview, unfolding starting with the first single "Apollo," reveals his expanded musical spectrum through various collaborations, centered on cinematic sound and vivid emotional lines. It marks a turning point where he has evolved beyond traditional progressive house toward a more mature and narrative sound.

The "Open to Close Set" to be held at UNDERCITY is a moment where his career, the narrative of his albums, and Vivrant's philosophy come together as one. For fans who have grown alongside his music, this night will remain a special experience to be remembered for a long time.

 1막 1장

궁전 안. 오늘은 왕자의 20세 생일날이다. 궁정의 처녀들과 즐겁게 춤을 추는 왕자와 친구들. 이때 여왕이 등장해 왕자가 성인이 된 것을 축하하며 선물로 칼을 준다. 사람들이 나간 후 혼자 남은 지그프리트 왕자는 알 수 없는 어떤 힘이 자꾸만 자신을 어디론가 인도하는 것을 느낀다. 

1막 2장

알 수 없는 힘에 이끌려 다다른 곳은 숲 속의 호숫가. 왕자는 호숫가에서 인간의 모습으로 변하는 백조들을 발견한다. 지그프리트 왕자는 그 중 가장 아름다운 오데트 공주에게 반한다. 그녀는 자신들은 천재적인 악마의 저주에 의해 낮에는 백조, 밤에는 사람으로 변하는 신세를 하소연하면서 이 저주의 마법에서 풀리려면 한 사람의 변치 않는 사랑을 받아야 한다고 말한다. 왕자는 사랑의 맹세를 하고 다음 날 있을 무도회에서 그녀와 결혼을 발표하기로 약속하고 헤어진다

2막 1장

궁전 무도회장. 왕자는 오데트가 오기 기다리면서 손님들을 맞는다. 왕자를 위해 폴란드, 러시아, 스페인, 헝가리, 나폴리에서 초대된 공주들 가운데 신부감을 고를 것을 종용 받지만 왕자는 별 뜻이 없다. 그때 악마가 자신의 딸 오딜을 데리고 등장한다. 오데트와 닮은 오딜에게 왕자는 달려간다. 악마는 이제부터 왕자의 감정을 시험하기 시작한다. 흑조 오딜의 매력에 빠져 왕자는 그녀와의 결혼을 발표한다. 이때 갑자기 어둠이 밀려오며 절망에 빠진 오데트의 환영이 나타난다. 왕자는 그제서야 자신이 운명의 장난에 놀아난 것을 깨닫고 백조의 호수가로 달려간다.  

2막 2장

호숫가. 왕자의 배신으로 영원히 백조로 살게 되었다며 오데트가 백조들에게 슬픈 소식을 전한다. 용서를 빌기 위해 달려온 왕자. 그러나 악마는 그를 오데트와 갈라놓기 위해 계속 방해를 한다. 왕자는 운명에 맞서 싸우려 하지만 악마의 힘은 대단하다. 그때 오데트가 왕자에게 당신을 용서한다고 말하는 순간 그들의 사랑이 악마의 악한 힘을 이겨내는 기적이 일어난다.

[Synopsis]

Act 1, Scene 1

Inside the palace. Today is the Prince's 20th birthday. The Prince and his friends are happily dancing with the court maidens. Just then, the Queen appears to congratulate the Prince on coming of age and presents him with a sword as a gift. After everyone leaves, Prince Siegfried, left alone, feels an unknown force repeatedly leading him somewhere.

Act 1, Scene 2

Led by this unknown force, he arrives at a lakeside in the forest. There, the Prince discovers swans that transform into human forms. Prince Siegfried falls for Princess Odette, the most beautiful of them all. She laments their fate, explaining that they are cursed by a genius devil to transform into swans by day and humans by night, and tells him that to break the spell, they must receive the unchanging love of one person. The Prince makes a vow of love, promises to announce their marriage at the ball the following day, and they part ways.

Act 2, Scene 1

The palace ballroom. The Prince greets guests while waiting for Odette to arrive. The prince is urged to choose a bride from among the princesses invited from Poland, Russia, Spain, Hungary, and Naples, but he shows little interest. Just then, the Devil appears with his daughter, Odile. The prince rushes toward Odile, who resembles Odette. The Devil begins to test the prince's emotions. Captivated by the charm of the Black Swan, Odile, the prince announces his marriage to her. At this moment, darkness suddenly descends, and a vision of a despairing Odette appears. Only then does the prince realize he has been played by the whims of fate and rushes to Swan Lake.

Act 2, Scene 2

The lakeside. Odette delivers the sad news to the swans, stating that due to the prince's betrayal, she is condemned to live as a swan forever. The prince rushes to beg for forgiveness. However, the Devil continues to interfere in an attempt to separate him from Odette. The prince tries to fight against fate, but the Devil's power is formidable. Just then, the moment Odette tells the prince that she forgives him, a miracle occurs in which their love overcomes the Devil's evil power.

이번 공연에서 임형주는 자신이 오랜 기간 음악감독으로 재직하고 있는 코리안 내셔널 필하모닉 앙상블의 환상적인 반주로 ‘천개의 바람이 되어‘, ’행복하길 바래(KBS 쾌걸춘향 OST)’를 비롯해 클래식, 팝, 뮤지컬, 가요 거기에 스페셜 7080 댄스곡까지 단아하고도 화려하고 서정적이면서도 웅장한 '팝페라의 진수'를 관객들에게 선보일 예정이다.

 
최근 EBS <서장훈의 이웃집 백만장자>, KBS <100인의 감정쇼 : 더 시그니처>, 채널A <4인용식탁>, TV조선 <아빠하고 나하고> 등의 그의 신비주의를 걷어낸 친근한 모습과 한층 가까워진 아름답고 정겨운 노래에 많은 대중들의 귀추가 주목될 것임이 틀림없다.

Lim Hyung-joo, a true legend of popera produced by Korea—whose achievements include being the first Korean to receive the UN Peace Medal, conquering the three major halls of Carnegie Hall in the U.S. with solo performances, signing distribution contracts for his solo album with the world's four major record labels, winning awards from Japan's NHK 'Kohaku Uta Gassen' and both the Obama and Trump Presidential Awards, serving as a voter and judge for the U.S. Grammy Awards, having a private audience and performance with Pope Francis, being a Lifetime Fellow of the Royal Society of Arts and receiving the FRSA title from the British Royal Family, receiving the Presidential Commendation of the Republic of Korea, and being the youngest recipient of the Order of Merit for Korean People, the Camellia Medal—will hold a New Spring Solo Concert titled 'Popera Sensation (The Emotion of Popera)!' at the Youngsan Art Hall in Yeouido, Seoul, on March 20 at 7:30 PM. [공연소개]

재즈 음반 레코드 레이블로 대중적인 인기는 물론 예술적인 성취의 측면에서 재즈 매니아들에게 블루노트(Blue Note) 가 가지는 상징성은 매우 크다. 블루노트에서 야심차게 영입한 신예 피아니스트 폴 코니쉬는 현재 미국 모던 색소폰의 거장 조슈아 레드맨의 밴드에서 활동하고 있으며, 그의 데뷔작이 블루노트에서 2025년에 발매되었다.

다수의 매체에서는 그의 데뷔작 <You're Exaggerating!>을 두고 블루노트가 다시한번 신선한 아이디어를 가진 새로운 아티스트를 찾는데 안목을 발휘하였다고 평가하며, 파이낸셜 타임즈는 “Blue Note strikes again” (블루노트가 다시 습격했다) 라는 헤드라인으로 블루노트와 폴 코니쉬의 조합을 평가했다. 블루노트의 수장인 돈 워스는 2025년 방한당시 인터뷰를 통해 재즈 리스너들이 새로 주목해야 하는 “매우 깊이 있는 차세대 연주자”라고 그를 연급하였다.

비밥의 거장 버드 파웰과 델로니우스 몽크를 연상시키는 고전적인 밥에서부터 제이슨 모란, 로버트 글래스퍼 등의 모던 피아니스트의 계보를 잇는 포스트밥 크리에이티브 재즈에 이르기까지, 폴 코니쉬 솔로 피아노 콘서트는 블루노트의 위대한 유산에 자신만의 독창적인 색채를 더해, 서정적이면서도 파워풀한 사운드의 연주로 21세기 모던 재즈 피아니즘의 정수를 느껴볼 수 있는 특별한 공연이 될 것이다.

[Concert Introduction]

As a jazz record label, Blue Note holds immense symbolic significance for jazz enthusiasts, not only in terms of popular appeal but also in terms of artistic achievement. Paul Cornish, a rising pianist ambitiously recruited by Blue Note, is currently active in the band of American modern saxophone virtuoso Joshua Redman, and his debut album was released by Blue Note in 2025.

Numerous media outlets have praised his debut album, *You're Exaggerating!*, noting that Blue Note has once again demonstrated its discerning eye in discovering new artists with fresh ideas. The Financial Times evaluated the collaboration between Blue Note and Paul Cornish under the headline, "Blue Note strikes again." During an interview following his visit to Korea in 2025, Don Wirth, the head of Blue Note, referred to him as a "very profound next-generation musician" whom jazz listeners should pay new attention to.

From classical bebop reminiscent of bebop masters Bud Powell and Thelonious Monk to post-bop creative jazz continuing the lineage of modern pianists such as Jason Moran and Robert Glasper, Paul Cornish's solo piano concert will be a special performance where you can experience the essence of 21st-century modern jazz pianism through a lyrical yet powerful sound, adding his own unique colors to the great legacy of Blue Note.

The puppet show *Sancho and Don Quixote* tells the story of Sancho, who embarks on an adventure with Don Quixote. Choi Rang, in the prime of her youth, full of curiosity and aspirations.

Having loved the unsparing love of her parents from a wealthy and happy home, she always tried her best to be a pretty daughter.

The sudden breeze of blossoming excitement in her heart feels awkward to her, but it is true that it is not a bad thing.

I want to love, too. Not the free love I have enjoyed until now, but the first love I can have as myself!

If only I could, I would pour out my love without regret. And I will protect that love forever and be happy for the rest of my life!

Life may be as hard as frozen ground, but I am always living as the me of today.

Broadcaster Jo Hye-ryeon’s first directorial and starring role!

A tenacious mother in the market during the 1980s... the story of our own mothers!

The play *I Love You, Mom*, which has garnered attention for featuring broadcaster Jo Hye-ryeon as both director and lead actress, tells the story of 'Ok-hee' in the 1980s. Having lost her husband, she has lived a life of tenacity, selling fish in the market while looking only for her son.

The play depicts the journey of 'Cheol-dong,' a naive son who took his mother's endless sacrifice for granted, as he belatedly comes to realize her true love.

The stage is filled with delightful laughter and heart-wrenching emotion that remind us of the mothers of our days.

In May, the Month of the Family, this will be a warm time for the whole family to laugh and cry together while reflecting on the love of parents that we may have forgotten.

전쟁 통에 헤어진 옛사랑을 찾아 나선 할아버지와, 멜로드라마를 꿈꾸던 손자의 가슴 뭉클한 진짜 이야기
 
화려한 무대 기법 없이도 꽉 채워지는 감동, 이것이 '진짜' 이야기의 힘!
연극 <나와 할아버지>는 극단 '공연배달서비스 간다'의 대표이자 연출가인 민준호의 실제 이야기를 바탕으로 만들어진 작품이다.
멋진 멜로드라마를 쓰고 싶어 하던 공연 대본 작가 '준희'가 외할아버지를 관찰하며 완성해 나가는 이 연극은, 인위적인 연출 없이 
소박하고 진솔한 우리네 삶의 풍경을 그려낸다. "할머니, 할아버지라고 부르는 그분들도 한때는 뜨거운 사랑을 했던 청춘이었다"는

[시놉시스]
멜로드라마가 쓰고 싶은 혈기만 왕성한 공연대본작가 '준희'
할아버지의 옛사랑을 찾아 나서게 되면서, 진짜 '삶'을 발견한다.
 
준희는 멋진 멜로드라마를 쓰고 싶은 혈기 넘치는 공연대본작가이다.
그의 선생님께서는 그의 외할머니와 할아버지를 관찰하고 완성해보란다.
 
하지만 글쓰기 시작도 전에 갑자기 쓰러지신 할머니.

할아버지의 지인까지 함께 찾아 나선다.

[Introduction]

A heartwarming true story about a grandfather who sets out to find his old love, separated by war, and his grandson who dreamed of writing a melodrama.

Emotion fills the space without flashy stage techniques—this is the power of a 'real' story!

The play *Me and My Grandfather* is based on the true story of Min Jun-ho, the representative and director of the theater company *Gongyeonbaedal Service Ganda*.

This play, which is completed by 'Jun-hee,' a playwright who wanted to write a magnificent melodrama, as she observes her maternal grandfather, portrays the simple and sincere landscapes of our lives without artificial direction.

It reminds us of the fact that "those we call Grandma and Grandpa were once young men who experienced passionate love,"

offering deep empathy and warm comfort that spans all generations.

[Synopsis]

'Jun-hee,' a playwright full of youthful vigor who wants to write a melodrama,

discovers true 'life' as he sets out to find his grandfather's old love.

Jun-hee is an energetic playwright who dreams of writing a wonderful melodrama.

His teacher instructs him to observe and complete his maternal grandmother and grandfather.

However, his grandmother suddenly collapses before he can even begin writing.

Eventually, Jun-hee begins observing only his grandfather,

recording his voice and listening to stories of his past.

He eventually sets out to find even his grandfather's acquaintance,

whom his grandmother had warned him "absolutely do not help with the search" before she collapsed.

As he listens to his grandfather's story, he gets the feeling that the person might be a woman! Could she be his grandfather's first love?

Driven by the hope that a melodrama might be completed, Jun-hee disobeys his grandmother's instructions and sets out to find Grandmother Im Su-im.

Will the interesting path Jun-hee wants to write lie ahead on that road?

고전 발레의 우아함과 현대 무용의 파격을 절묘하게 결합하여 세계 무용 팬들을 사로잡은 모나코 몬테카를로 발레단이 장 크리스토프 마이요의 수작 [백조의 호수]로 한국 관객을 매혹한다. 마이요는 원작의 동화적 환상을 걷어내고, 흑과 백, 선과 악, 순수와 욕망의 대비를 세련된 미장센으로 풀어내며 ‘백조’를 인간 내면을 파고드는 치밀한 심리 드라마로 변주했다. 차이콥스키 원곡을 바탕으로 새롭게 구성한 음악은 코리아 쿱 오케스트라의 라이브 연주로 작품의 긴장감과 감정선을 더욱 풍성하게 만들어 줄 것이다.

[Performance Introduction]

A Black-and-White Thriller Stripped of Fairytale Fantasy

The Monaco Monte Carlo Ballet, which has captivated dance fans worldwide by exquisitely combining the elegance of classical ballet with the unconventionality of contemporary dance, enchants Korean audiences with Jean-Christophe Maillot's masterpiece, *Swan Lake*. Maillot strips away the fairytale fantasy of the original work and transforms the "Swan" into an intricate psychological drama that delves into the human psyche, unfolding the contrasts of black and white, good and evil, and purity and desire through sophisticated mise-en-scène. The music, newly composed based on Tchaikovsky's original score, will be performed live by the Korea Coop Orchestra, further enriching the tension and emotional depth of the production.

[공연소개]


재즈 음반 레코드 레이블로 대중적인 인기는 물론 예술적인 성취의 측면에서 재즈 매니아들에게 블루노트(Blue Note) 가 가지는 상징성은 매우 크다. 블루노트에서 야심차게 영입한 신예 피아니스트 폴 코니쉬는 현재 미국 모던 색소폰의 거장 조슈아 레드맨의 밴드에서 활동하고 있으며, 그의 데뷔작이 블루노트에서 2025년에 발매되었다.

 
다수의 매체에서는 그의 데뷔작 <You're Exaggerating!>을 두고 블루노트가 다시한번 신선한 아이디어를 가진 새로운 아티스트를 찾는데 안목이 있다고 평가하며, 파이낸셜 타임즈는 “Blue Note strikes again” (블루노트가 다시 습격했다) 라는 헤드라인으로 블루노트와 폴 코니쉬의 조합을 평가했다. 음반에 참여했던 오리지널 멤버들로 진행하는 이번 첫 내한공연은 조슈아 크럼블리(베이스), 조나단 핀슨(드럼)의 트리오 구성으로 현재 미국 재즈씬을 대표하는 젊은 연주자들의 생동감 넘치는 연주와 에너지를 직접 접해볼 수 있다.


비밥의 거장 버드 파웰과 델로니우스 뭉크를 연상시키는 고전적인 밥에서부터 제이슨 모란, 로버트 글래스퍼 등의 모던 피아니스트의 계보를 잇는 포스트밥 크리에이티브 재즈에 이르기까지, 폴 코니쉬 트리오 첫 내한공연은 블루노트의 위대한 유산에 자신만의 독창적인 색채를 더해, 서정적이면서 파워풀한 사운드의 연주로 21세기 재즈 피아니즘의 정수를 느껴볼 수 있는 공연이 될 것이다.



[폴 코니쉬 소개]


2023년 아메리칸 피아노 어워즈 그리고 허비 행콕 국제 재즈 피아노 컴페티션에서 최종 후보로 오르며, 3위로 우승을 하였던 그는 그의 젊은 감각과 완벽한 실력을 인정받으며 Joshua Redman, Louis Cole, Mark Guiliana 등의 세션으로 광범위한 활동을 펼쳤다. 올해 29세가 되는 그는 이미 거장과 같은 성숙함과 재즈의 인터플레이에 필요한 민첩성과 창의성을 나타내며, 블루노트에서 발탁한 감각적인 피아니스트이다.
TranslationFormula:
[Concert Introduction]

As a jazz record label, Blue Note holds immense symbolic significance for jazz enthusiasts, not only for its popular appeal but also for its artistic achievements. Paul Cornish, a rising pianist ambitiously recruited by Blue Note, is currently active in the band of American modern saxophone virtuoso Joshua Redman, and his debut album was released by Blue Note in 2025.

Numerous media outlets have praised his debut album, *You're Exaggerating!*, as demonstrating that Blue Note once again possesses a keen eye for discovering new artists with fresh ideas. The Financial Times evaluated the combination of Blue Note and Paul Cornish under the headline, "Blue Note strikes again." This first performance in Korea, featuring the original members who participated in the album, is composed of a trio consisting of Joshua Crumbley (bass) and Jonathan Pinson (drums), offering the opportunity to experience firsthand the vibrant performance and energy of these young musicians who represent the current American jazz scene.

**Concert Introduction** From classical bebop reminiscent of bebop masters Bud Powell and Thelonious Munch to post-bop creative jazz continuing the lineage of modern pianists such as Jason Moran and Robert Glasper, the Paul Cornish Trio's first performance in Korea adds his own unique colors to the great legacy of Blue Note. Through a performance featuring a lyrical yet powerful sound, this concert promises to be an opportunity to experience the essence of 21st-century jazz pianism.

[About Paul Cornish]

Having been a finalist at the 2023 American Piano Awards and the Herbie Hancock International Jazz Piano Competition, where he won third place, he has been recognized for his youthful sensibility and impeccable skill, engaging in extensive session work with artists such as Joshua Redman, Louis Cole, and Mark Guiliana. Turning 29 this year, he already displays the maturity of a master as well as the agility and creativity required for jazz interplay, making him a talented pianist discovered by Blue Note.

Original:
[공연소개]



미씽 Missing

현대무용 × 인터랙티브 미디어 아트



적응의 기록, 멈추지 않는 몸

잃어버린 세계에서 당신의 몸은 어떤 기록을 남기겠습니까



무엇이 사라졌는가.

자연인가, 공기인가, 감각인가.

아니면 우리가 알고 있던 인간의 형태인가.



〈미씽 Missing〉은 변화된 환경 속에서 스스로를 재조직하는 인간의 몸을 관찰한다. 이 작품에서 몸은 감정을 표현하는 주체가 아니다. 몸은 환경에 반응하는 구조이며, 끊임없이 적응하는 시스템이다.



미씽(Missing)이 가리키는 것은 단순한 사라짐이 아니다. 익숙했던 감각의 상실, 이전의 호흡 방식, 자연과의 관계, 그리고 인간을 규정하던 형태의 일부가 지워진 상태. 그러나 이 작품은 그 상실을 애도하지 않는다. 사라진 이후에도 계속해서 변형되고 적응하는 몸을 조용히 들여다본다.



[시놉시스]



랩으로 감겨진 몸이 무대 위에 있다. 억압의 표시가 아니라, 하나의 조건이다. 먼지와 독성으로 가득한 환경 속에서 몸은 스스로를 감싸고, 제한된 조건 안에서 기능을 다시 설계한다. 그 몸 위로 미디어 아트가 겹쳐지며 신체는 왜곡되고 변형되고 다시 태어난다.



몸은 바닥을 향한다. 인공물 사이에서 끝내 남아있는 자연, 흙과의 접촉. 피부를 통해, 움직임을 통해, 세포 단위에서 다시 깨어나는 몸. 무용수들의 움직임은 파장과 등고선의 형태로 공간 위에 펼쳐지며 인터랙티브 미디어와 실시간으로 호응한다.



환경이 바뀌면 몸도 바뀐다. 아름다움의 기준이 사라진 자리에서 몸은 새로운 균형을 만들어낸다. 물리적으로 불가능한 신체의 왜곡이 미디어를 통해 가시화되며, 진화의 흔적은 무대 위에서 낯선 형태로 드러난다.



그럼에도 인간은 관계를 포기하지 않는다. 밀고 당기고 어긋나고 엮이며, 변형된 몸들은 함께 적응한다. 관계의 본질은 환경이 변해도 그대로다.



노래가 흐른다. 몸은 그 소리에 반응한다. 언어가 닿지 않는 곳에서, 몸은 본능적으로 자연을 향해 움직인다. 왜곡되고 변화했지만 희망을 포기하지 않는 몸. 〈미씽〉은 사라진 것을 복원하는 작업이 아니다. 사라짐 이후에도 계속해서 변형되고 적응하며 살아가는 몸에 대한 탐구다. 이 작품이 끝난 뒤, 관객이 잠시 자신의 호흡과 몸을 의식한다면 그것으로 충분하다.
TranslationFormula:
[Performance Introduction]

Missing

Contemporary Dance × Interactive Media Art

A Record of Adaptation, an Unceasing Body

In a lost world, what record will your body leave behind?

What has disappeared?

Nature, air, or senses?

Or is it the human form we knew?

<Missing> observes the human body reorganizing itself within a changed environment. In this work, the body is not a subject that expresses emotions. The body is a structure that responds to the environment and a system that constantly adapts.

What "Missing" refers to is not a simple disappearance. It signifies the loss of familiar senses, previous breathing patterns, the relationship with nature, and a state in which parts of the form that defined humanity have been erased. However, this work does not mourn that loss. It quietly observes the body that continues to transform and adapt even after it has vanished.

[Synopsis]

A body wrapped in plastic wrap sits on the stage. It is not a sign of oppression, but a condition. In an environment filled with dust and toxins, the body wraps itself and redesigns its functions within limited conditions. As media art overlaps the body, the physical form is distorted, transformed, and reborn.

The body faces the floor. Contact with the earth—nature that ultimately remains amidst the artifacts. A body that awakens again at the cellular level, through the skin and through movement. The dancers' movements unfold across the space in the form of waves and contour lines, responding in real-time with interactive media.

When the environment changes, the body changes too. In the place where standards of beauty have vanished, the body creates a new balance. Physically impossible bodily distortions are visualized through media, and traces of evolution are revealed on the stage in unfamiliar forms.

Nevertheless, humans do not give up on relationships. Pushing and pulling, misaligned and intertwined, the transformed bodies adapt together. The essence of relationships remains the same, even as the environment changes.

A song flows. The body responds to the sound. In a place where language cannot reach, the body instinctively moves toward nature. A body that is distorted and changed, yet does not give up hope. *Missing* is not a work that restores what has disappeared. It is an exploration of the body that continues to transform and adapt, living on even after vanishing. If, after this piece ends, the audience becomes conscious of their breathing and body for a moment, that is enough.

[Performance Introduction]

1. <NODE>

Choreographed by Shim Jae-ho, <NODE> explores the structure of the "group" that humans have formed for survival, and the mechanism of "division" that inevitably arises within it. We form groups to connect with one another, but as the group expands, differences in standards become boundaries, creating new separations. Within the structure of human society, which becomes more finely divided the more broadly connected it becomes, the individual begins to be defined by "where they belong."

Rather than asserting this structure, the work poses the question of whether a society that is complete as a single entity is possible. Here, "node" signifies a state where each individual exists as a single point rather than as a massive whole; the piece seeks to explore, through the body, relationships that coexist in an invisible tension, neither completely merged nor severed.

2. <Walk and Waltz>

Everyone walks. But how much do we truly gaze at the life hidden within those steps? Choreographed by Kim Young-woong, *Walk and Waltz* is an experimental creation themed "floating in the rhythm of life," taking "walking," the most mundane human act, as the starting point of the dance. Through the everyday act of walking, this work seeks to capture the inner voices and life experiences that humans encounter while living. The dancer's steps extend beyond simple movement to expand into a flow of emotions, and traces of daily life are reconstructed into visual movements. The stage, utilizing light, sound, and the textures of costumes, sensuously reveals the theme of "a body walking through time."

[Introduction]

Between Morality and Survival: The Price of Choices Women Had to Bear

We present *Mrs. Warren's Profession* by George Bernard Shaw, a Nobel Prize winner in Literature and a leading British critic, thinker, and playwright. This work caused a sensation upon its release by sharply criticizing the structural inequality in British society that economically oppresses women through the "prostitute issue." It also draws attention for the fact that five-time Olivier Award winner Imelda Staunton plays the mother-daughter role alongside her own daughter, Bessie Carter, for the first time. Furthermore, this production is a new collaboration between Imelda Staunton and director Dominic Cooke, deeply illuminating human choice and responsibility at the point where morality and independence, and tradition and progress, collide.

[Synopsis]

Bibi Warren is a young woman of intellect and independence who has just graduated from college. She discovers that her mother, Kitty Warren, had built her wealth in the past through socially unacceptable means to make a living. Bibi questions whether her mother's choice was morally justified, while grappling with the reality that it is not a thing of the past. The values ​​of the daughter, who seeks to live according to her convictions, clash with those of the mother, who had to survive in a patriarchal society. But what was the true price of the immense wealth Mrs. Warren amassed?

A Friendly Ballet to Listen to and Enjoy with Your Eyes: *Swan Lake*

Presented by the Seoul City Ballet, *Swan Lake* is a "tailored to your level" performance designed to break the stereotype that ballet is difficult by combining the dancers' beautiful movements with friendly commentary, allowing people of all ages to enjoy it easily and entertainingly. The story begins with Prince Siegfried meeting Princess Odette, the Swan Queen cursed by the sorcerer Rothbart, at a lake in the forest and pledging their fated love. [Synopsis]

Prologue: The Prince's Coming-of-Age Ceremony

After holding a grand coming-of-age ceremony and receiving a bow as a gift, Prince Siegfried sees a swan flying by and goes hunting by the lake with his friends.

Act 1: Scene at the Lakeside

Prince Siegfried, having followed the swan into the forest, is attacked by wolves and Rothbart by the lakeside, but overcomes the attack with the help of the swans.

He discovers Princess Odette, who is transforming into a human, falls in love at first sight, and proposes to her.

Hearing that the princess must receive the eternal love of one person to be freed from the devil's spell, Prince Siegfried pledges his vow of love.

Act 2: The Palace Ballroom

Prince Siegfried greets guests while waiting for Princess Odette to arrive.

While his friends and a ladybug are enjoying a party together,

the devil Rothbart appears with his daughter Odile, who resembles Princess Odette. Prince Siegfried, mistaking Odile—brought by the devil Rothbart—for Princess Odette, announces his marriage to her and, at Rothbart's request, promises eternal love. At this moment, the devil Rothbart reveals his true nature, and as Odile disappears, Prince Siegfried, overcome with grief, runs into the forest.

Act 3: Eternal Love
Princess Odette, condemned to live forever as a swan due to Prince Siegfried's betrayal. Prince Siegfried, who has come seeking forgiveness, and Princess Odette mourn their fate together, but they defeat the devil Rothbart through the power of love and promise eternal love.

[Performance Introduction]

A Living, Moving Book: Don Quixote Unfolded as a Puppet Show

The puppet show *Sancho and Don Quixote* has been reimagined to allow even young children who cannot yet read to easily and enjoyably encounter the message of the book *Don Quixote*.

The story begins with Sancho, a nine-year-old boy, opening a "book" that leads him into a world of adventure. The staging, utilizing various types of puppets—such as jointed, board, and shadow puppets—along with pop-up books, portrays Don Quixote's absurd adventures on stage with even greater persuasiveness. Along with the actors' comical performances, music, including medieval-style dance tunes, adds romance to the artistic imagination.

[Synopsis]

The Story of Sancho Embarking on an Adventure with Don Quixote

Whenever you open a book in a strange and mysterious old bookstore, a different adventure awaits.

The adventure awaiting today is the story of the knight Don Quixote. An ordinary boy who enters the bookstore is called "Sancho" and, led by Don Quixote, sets out on a quest to become an honorable knight. As Sancho sets out on his journey with Don Quixote, unimaginable events occur at every turn, such as the appearance of windmill giants and black-maned lions… Just then, a massive dragon appears before their eyes! Faced with a dragon they can neither defeat nor avoid, what will happen to Sancho and Don Quixote?

TranslationFormula:
[Performance Introduction]

The Magic Flute, the final opera left behind by the genius composer Mozart, will be performed on the stage of the Korea National Opera, representing Korea. This work, which depicts the journey of a man and a woman overcoming trials to find love amidst the conflict between reason and emotion symbolized by night and day, has been loved by people all over the world for over 200 years since its premiere in 1791. In addition to fantastic melodies including the "Queen of the Night" aria, the performance is structured to allow anyone to easily and enjoyably immerse themselves in the story, featuring Korean subtitles for the arias and dialogue in Korean. We hope the whole family will come together to savor this magical musical feast presented by Mozart.

[Synopsis]

This is a Singschwill (a German opera with dialogue interspersed like a play) completed by Mozart two months before his death.

By adding Mozart's beautiful music and comedic elements to a simple story of lovers and a battle between good and evil, this work remains beloved to this day, approximately 200 years after its premiere in 1791. In a world where the 'forces of light' ruled by Sarastro and the 'forces of darkness' ruled by the Queen of the Night are in conflict, Tamino, pursued by a giant snake, loses consciousness and is rescued by the Queen of the Night's three handmaidens. The Queen of the Night shows Tamino a portrait of her daughter, Pamina, and asks him to save her. The three handmaidens present a magic flute to Tamino, who has fallen in love with Pamina's portrait, and he sets off with Papageno to rescue Pamina, who has been captured by Sarastro. After many twists and turns, Tamino meets Pamina, and they confirm their love for each other and undergo Sarastro's trials to achieve their love.
